EA-24.name: Risk-based documentation, traceability, configuration and governance
EA-24.original_form: Documentation and controls were de-emphasised relative to working software.
EA-24.mechanism: Maintain authoritative living evidence proportional to consequence, longevity, turnover, interface and external obligation.
EA-24.mature_form: Document what another decision, operator, maintainer or authority must be able to know and verify.
EA-24.trigger: Regulation, safety, security, multiple organisations, long asset life, maintenance or auditability.
EA-24.native_cheap_path: For a low-risk small system, retain only the decision, interface, operation and recovery information needed by its actual users.
EA-24.ceremony_distinction: A template, wiki or audit packet is not intrinsically valuable.
EA-24.criticism: ‘Working software over comprehensive documentation’ was often distorted into anti-documentation doctrine.
